notes.title: Update: Achievements Now Available in The Falling Star!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]Just a small update—Steam achievements are now live in The Falling Star! [/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who’s already played and supported the game. Your kindness means the world, and I hope this little addition brings new joy if you ever revisit. 💫[/p][p]This game was originally created as a student project during my final semester. Seeing it reach so many people has meant more than I can express. If it resonated with you, a short review would truly help others discover it too:) [/p][p]With love,
Yeariver[/p]
